facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list dated 2 February 2026 records Senegal as having ratified the AU Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection on 3 August 2016 and deposited the instrument on 16 August 2016, with no signature date shown; 20 of 55 states had deposited.
